from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from delta.tables import *
from pyspark.sql.functions import max
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd

reference_day = datetime.now()-relativedelta(months=1)
reference_next_month = '%02d' % (datetime.now().month)
reference_month = '%02d' % reference_day.month
reference_year = reference_day.year
reference_year_month = f"{reference_year}{reference_month}"

sourcefile = f"abfss://pfstage@fatpsa.dfs.core.windows.net/send/count/notification/{reference_year}/{reference_month}/*"
tablename = "fat_delta.notification_count"

dfNewFile_notification = spark.read.format("parquet").load(sourcefile)
dfNewFile_notification = dfNewFile_notification.withColumn("SourceFile",  F.lit(sourcefile))


dfNewFile_notification.write.format("delta").mode("append").saveAsTable(tablename)
print(sourcefile)
print(tablename)
